name: Five phone tabs; logo restored; no hamburger or document editor menu
Home month and history summary match selected user without mixing currencies
Entries has Active and Pending, without History button
History month filter shows submitted records without print/summary
Connection details float without moving page; outside and X close
Connection indicator red offline and orange for weak service
Ledger drill-down, month/quarter/year and running balances
Automatic sync retains immutable reference and confirms receipt
Other users and saved-record edits are excluded from phone autosync
Post retains both entry switches and existing draft controls
